leadText:
Sparkle! (Japanese: ピッカーン！ Pikkaan!) is the Japanese ending theme for the Rayquaza Rising arc and the third of Pokémon Horizons: The Series. It debuted as an ending song in HZ068, replacing Let me battle. It aired until HZ088, when it was replaced by Ready Go.

The full version of the song was first released as a digital single on October 18, 2024.
plainText:
Sparkle! (Japanese: ピッカーン！ Pikkaan!) is the Japanese ending theme for the Rayquaza Rising arc and the third of Pokémon Horizons: The Series. It debuted as an ending song in HZ068, replacing Let me battle. It aired until HZ088, when it was replaced by Ready Go.

The full version of the song was first released as a digital single on October 18, 2024. 

==Ending animation==
===Synopsis===
Six silhouettes stand in front of a brick wall, adorned with neon signs of the , , , and types, as well as the symbol of the Rising Volt Tacklers. As the camera zooms in, the six silhouettes raise their hands before jumping on the beat as the spotlight comes on, revealing to be Liko, Roy, Dot, and their respective partner Pokémon. Under a green lighting, Liko and dance to the music before Dot and transition across the screen to change the focus to Roy and dancing under a red lighting on the opposite side of the screen. The focus returns to the six of them as they dance together, with the outstretched hands of the s creating a light that makes a white screen.

On a green screen, Liko and are above Indigo Academy. A red screen comes up next, with Roy and being above the former's island. Finally, a blue screen appears with Dot and hovering above Levincia. Liko, with her eyes closed, circles around the screen and fills it with pink mist. swims around before the camera focuses on Liko, who opens her eyes. Liko runs alone on a pink background, later being joined by Sprigatito and , who then change into Floragato and . The camera zooms out, revealing the trio running to be a disc on a player that is surrounded by various items such as a Rotom Phone and Captain Pikachu's hat. A figure of Terapagos in its appears in the middle of the screen, with figures of the first partner Pokémon sprouting from it.

The scene changes to the younger members of the Rising Volt Tacklers and their Pokémon. The camera pans over them before switching to the rear view of them jumping (except for , who is flying instead) towards the sky. As the camera rises up, the Brave Olivine is facing the same direction while the Black Rayquaza is ahead of everyone else before breaking into a film-like montage. Floragato turns to face the camera behind her, and the scene repeats with a grid of nine rectangles, with Liko and Hattrem doing the same in pink rectangles and Terapagos smiling in front of Floragato in another rectangle. Crocalor, Roy, and Kilowattrel line up wearing shades as they spread out horizontally. Nidothing, Quaxwell, and leap to the left of the screen as a shadow of Dot is shown behind Nidothing's suit.

Five shadows appear on the screen before they quickly go up, revealing to belong to the older members of the Rising Volt Tacklers as they dance surrounded by their own partner Pokémon and the wild Pokémon living aboard the Brave Olivine. Liko and Floragato dance in front of a brick wall under a green lighting before switching to Roy and Crocalor under a red one. Floragato, Crocalor, and Quaxwell bounce around on an equalizer in front of an image of Captain Pikachu before leaping out of the screen.

==Trivia==
This is the first Japanese theme song that was sung by a group since the third variant of One, Two, Three.
During its initial debut in HZ068, no song credits were given in the ending animation and only the producers and composer were announced alongside teasing who the singers might be. On October 16th, 2024, five days after the airing of the episode, the singers were revealed to be Rina Matsuda & Hikaru Morita from Sakurazaka46. In the following episode, the song credits were first properly given.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
This is the first Japanese theme song that was sung by a group since the third variant of One, Two, Three.
During its initial debut in HZ068, no song credits were given in the ending animation and only the producers and composer were announced alongside teasing who the singers might be. On October 16th, 2024, five days after the airing of the episode, the singers were revealed to be Rina Matsuda & Hikaru Morita from Sakurazaka46. In the following episode, the song credits were first properly given.

aiReadySummary.title: Sparkle!
aiReadySummary.searchableText:
Sparkle!
Category:Japanese ending themes
Sparkle! (Japanese: ピッカーン！ Pikkaan!) is the Japanese ending theme for the Rayquaza Rising arc and the third of Pokémon Horizons: The Series. It debuted as an ending song in HZ068, replacing Let me battle. It aired until HZ088, when it was replaced by Ready Go.

The full version of the song was first released as a digital single on October 18, 2024.
